in_hebrew.name: Hanshaw
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is gracious
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hanshaw הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old High German, Hanz (God) and scu (grace). The name Hanshaw signifies 'God is gracious'. In Christian traditions, it is a reminder of God's endless mercy and kindness towards believers.

The name Hanshaw signifies 'God is gracious'. In Christian traditions, it is a reminder of God's endless mercy and kindness towards believers.

in_latin.name: Hanshaw
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God is gracious
